mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the distributors, competitors, suppliers, government, salesmen and buyers. 4."
The parties are the distributors, competitors, suppliers, government, salesmen and buyers. 4.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the procedure used to remove excess moisture from the seed to reduce moisture to a level acceptable for safe storage or for commercial sale."
Drying is the procedure used to remove excess moisture from the seed to reduce moisture to a level acceptable for safe storage or for commercial sale.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important factor for initiating and mobilisation of the processed food during germination. 3."
Availability of oxygen is the most important factor for initiating and mobilisation of the processed food during germination. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of seed processing."
Packaging and safe storage is an integral part of seed processing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a highly skilled work and is only possible if the rouges are seen."
The art of rouging is a highly skilled work and is only possible if the rouges are seen.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the result of sound scientific knowledge, organised effort, investment on processing, storage and marketing facilities, whereas no such effort or knowledge is required in grain production. 3."
Seed is the result of sound scientific knowledge, organised effort, investment on processing, storage and marketing facilities, whereas no such effort or knowledge is required in grain production. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the physical, physiological, pathological and genetic attributes which contributes to final crop yield."
Seed quality is the physical, physiological, pathological and genetic attributes which contributes to final crop yield.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of seed processing which must not be handled with levity."
Seed packaging as earlier stated is an integral part of seed processing which must not be handled with levity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important activities of seed certification, without which it would be difficult to determine the genuineness of the seed produced."
Field inspection is one of the most important activities of seed certification, without which it would be difficult to determine the genuineness of the seed produced.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as marketing variables or marketing mix."
The principles of marketing are referred to as marketing variables or marketing mix.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the period during which a seed remains viable and can germinate when exposed to favourable conditions until when viability is lost."
Seed longevity refers to the period during which a seed remains viable and can germinate when exposed to favourable conditions until when viability is lost.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition in which viable seeds fail to germinate even when provided with optimal conditions for germination."
Seed dormancy is a condition in which viable seeds fail to germinate even when provided with optimal conditions for germination.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ability of some seeds in a seed lot to overcome or withstand adverse conditions during germination and produce seedlings of uniform growth with the rest seeds."
Seed vigour refers to the ability of some seeds in a seed lot to overcome or withstand adverse conditions during germination and produce seedlings of uniform growth with the rest seeds.

Dormancy in general sense
Dormancy in general sense is the period between seed maturity and seed germination.

regional offices

Marketing

Foundation seed

drying of seeds

dealers and distributors

Germination

plan
